summary: The 2026 FIFA World Cup is now underway, drawing a record number of MLS players as the league enters its six-week hiatus through July 16. In EPL news, the 2025-26 season has concluded with Arsenal crowned champions and West Ham, Burnley, and Wolverhampton relegated, while the summer transfer window opens June 15 with Jadon Sancho set to depart Manchester United on a free.
headlines: Record MLS player contingent heads to 2026 FIFA World Cup as league pauses through July 16
